messages.content: mero sanga 1200 rupiya thiyo. 450 ko jutta kine. aba kati baki?
aba 750 rupiya baki chha.
euta copy 45 rupiya. 6 ota copy kinda kati lagchha?
6 ota copy kinda 270 rupiya lagchha.
96 ota mithai 8 jana bich barabar bandda ek jana le kati paunchha?
ek jana le 12 ota mithai paunchha.
kaksha ma 23 keta ra 19 keti chhan. jamma kati?
kaksha ma jamma 42 jana chhan.
bus ma 31 purush ra 26 mahila yatri chhan. purush kati jana badhi?
purush 5 jana badhi chhan.
dudh 1 liter ko 110 rupiya. 3 liter ra adha liter kinda kati?
3.5 liter dudh ko 385 rupiya parchha.
bike le ghanta ma 40 km jaanchha. 3 ghanta ma kati km?
3 ghanta ma 120 km jaanchha.
80 ko 25 percent kati hunchha?
300 rupiya ko saman ma 10% discount bhayo bhane kati tirnu parchha?
270 rupiya tirnu parchha.
ma 1995 ma janmeko. 2025 ma kati barsha ko hunchhu?
2025 ma tapai 30 barsha ko hunuhunchha (janmadin aaisakeko bhaye).
hapta ko 7 din, 5 hapta ma kati din?
5 hapta ma 35 din hunchha.
ek darjan anda ma 12 hunchha. 4 darjan ma kati?
4 darjan ma 48 ota anda hunchha.
ghadi ma ahile 10:45 bhayo. 30 minet pachhi kati baje?
30 minet pachhi 11:15 hunchha.
mero bank ma 5000 thiyo. 3 mahina samma mahina ko 1500 thape. aba kati?
aba bank ma 9500 rupiya chha.
